correctness.rationale: The exact equality criterion inside Zhu’s auxiliary-graph comparison is sound and forces paths as the only all-connected-bipartite BHM equality case. The zero-edge contraction proof of the gap-transfer inequality is also correct.

originality.rationale: Wu--Xu--Zhu (2016) already state equality iff the tree is a path for both the lazy and standard tree inequalities. The repaired claim therefore narrows novelty to the all-connected-bipartite BHM equality classification and the quantitative gap transfer, neither of which was found in the compared sources.

scientific_value.rationale: The retained contributions classify equality in Zhu’s newly proved BHM theorem over all connected bipartite graphs and give a quantitative bridge from the standard model to the lazy model.

checked_sources.finding: Current v1 proves the BHM expectation theorem for all connected bipartite graphs and derives LNR; it does not state the complete BHM equality classification.

limitations: Direct opening of the 2016 author-hosted PDF timed out during this audit; the relevant theorem text was nevertheless exposed by the search index and is quoted only at the level needed for attribution.

repair_note: The mathematical proofs are correct, but the prior originality discussion was materially incomplete. Wu--Xu--Zhu (2016) explicitly state unique-path equality for both tree inequalities in Corollaries 2.6 and 2.12. The repaired record no longer claims those tree equality cases or the resulting lazy uniqueness package as new; novelty is restricted to the all-connected-bipartite BHM equality classification and the general quantitative gap transfer.
